ns2:course.label: Food Processing II
ns2:course.description: Laboratory course for FSHN 461. Includes labs on blanching, pasteurization, sterilization, freezing, freeze drying, dehydration (tray drying, drum drying and spray drying), evaporation, and extrusion; discussion and labs. Prerequisite: FSHN 461.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: There may be a fee for Class Materials for some sections of this course.
